content: {"episode_id":"ep-05025","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"This claim for CPT 93229, Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring, was denied under CO-197 for precertification or prior authorization not obtained before services were rendered. The clinical indication note documents recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness consistent with supraventricular tachycardia (I47.1), occurring against a background of known atherosclerotic heart disease of the native coronary artery (I25.10). Mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to capture intermittent arrhythmic events and correlate symptoms with rhythm disturbances in an outpatient setting."}
